tasks.label: docker: start kafka
tasks.detail: Start the Kafka broker and wait until it is healthy

tasks.label: docker: start kafka + api container
tasks.detail: Build the fraud-api image and start it with Kafka, waiting for both to be healthy

tasks.label: docker: stop all
tasks.detail: Stop and remove the Kafka and API containers

tasks.label: wait: api ready
tasks.detail: Poll the FastAPI service on port 8000 for up to 90 seconds
tasks.command: for ($i = 0; $i -lt 90; $i++) { try { Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 2 http://127.0.0.1:8000/ | Out-Null; Write-Host 'API is up'; exit 0 } catch { Start-Sleep -Seconds 1 } }; Write-Error 'API did not start on port 8000'; exit 1

tasks.label: wait: fraud service ready
tasks.detail: Poll the streaming fraud service on port 8001 for up to 120 seconds
tasks.command: for ($i = 0; $i -lt 120; $i++) { try { Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 2 http://127.0.0.1:8001/ | Out-Null; Write-Host 'Fraud service is up'; exit 0 } catch { Start-Sleep -Seconds 1 } }; Write-Error 'Fraud service did not start on port 8001'; exit 1

tasks.label: setup: streaming track (feature store, GNN export, stream model)
tasks.detail: One-time: build Feast store, export the GNN for serving, train the stream model

tasks.label: setup: reset replay (rebuild Feast online store, clear cases)
tasks.detail: Re-bootstrap the online store to REPLAY_START_STEP, delete scored cases, skip old Kafka messages; stop the fraud service first
tasks.command: Remove-Item -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue data/serving/fraud_cases.db*; docker exec fraud-kafka /opt/kafka/bin/kafka-consumer-groups.sh --bootstrap-server localhost:9092 --group paysim-fraud-service --topic transactions --reset-offsets --to-latest --execute; & '${command:python.interpreterPath}' scripts/feast/build_feature_store.py

tasks.label: setup: install dependencies
tasks.detail: Install dev requirements and the fraud_detection package into the selected interpreter
